title: English Practice Quiz 0473
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: She is the ___ student in the class.
questions.explanation: Use the superlative tallest when comparing one with the whole class.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: After doesn't, use the base form of the verb: like.

questions.question: I ___ him last week.
questions.explanation: Use the past simple with a finished past time such as last week.

questions.question: I saw ___ elephant at the zoo.
questions.explanation: Use an before a vowel sound.

questions.question: You look tired. You ___ get some rest.
Which word has a silent 'k'?
questions.explanation: The k in know is silent.

questions.question: To confirm an instruction, you can say:
options: Could you please confirm the details?
questions.explanation: Could you please confirm... is polite and precise.

questions.question: Please ___ the correct answer.
questions.explanation: Choose is the base verb used after please.

questions.question: He said, 'I am tired.' Reported speech:
options: He said that he was tired.
questions.explanation: In standard backshift, am changes to was after a past reporting verb.

questions.question: She arrived ___.
questions.explanation: Late is the correct adverb meaning not on time.
